name: Nabisco Memphis Sales Distribution Center - Memphis TN

fieldNotes.location: Roster coords (35.1175,-89.9711) were a downtown-Memphis centroid ~16 km NW of the real site. Resolved to 5812 Distribution Dr, Memphis TN 38141 via web research; Shelby County tax-assessor records confirm the 5812 parcel is owned by MONDELEZ GLOBAL LLC. Locked center 35.0184,-89.8695 in the SE Memphis (Lamar/Getwell) industrial corridor.
fieldNotes.facilityType: Genuine freight facility - a single-story Nabisco/Mondelez sales-distribution warehouse, not an office. Freight relevance HIGH.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Property is fully chain-link fenced. Street View shows a gate opening at the office-front entrance off Distribution Dr; no manned guard booth is visible at the gate - classified truckGate true, guardShack false, remoteGs true (kiosk / call-box check-in implied). guardShack/remoteGs flagged uncertain since a small booth could be obscured.
fieldNotes.docks: Long dock bank fronting Distribution Dr on the north building face; Street View shows a continuous run of dock doors with trailers/pallets staged. Counted ~22 doors -> band 10-25.
fieldNotes.dropArea: A row of trailers and several tractors parked on the north apron / yard; capacity ~25 -> band 10-25. dropYard true.
fieldNotes.railServed: A rail line runs E-W immediately along the SOUTH edge of the building, but it reads as a through-line with no spur or rail dock into the property - classified false, flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.drivewayShort: Short entrance drive from Distribution Dr into the yard - only 1-2 truck depth before the apron.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Dense SE Memphis industrial park, surrounded by warehouses and metro fabric - Urban.
